parsed.rationale: The cluster surfaces two exact-duplicate initializers — `MaterialView.init(blurRadius:overlayOpacity:isDark:cornerRadius:)` — at lines 35 and 168 of the same file `Shared/Wallpaper/Sources/Wallpaper/MaterialView.swift` in the `Wallpaper` package. Both records carry all context flags as `false`, ruling out test, codegen, sample-app, or mock explanations. Swift does not permit two declarations with identical signatures in the same type scope without a compiler error, so one of these is either dead code, guarded by a currently-inactive `#if` block, or an accidental copy that has gone unnoticed. The duplicate at line 168 (133 lines after the canonical one at line 35) should be investigated and removed.
